scenes.script: In the city of Velmora, more people ride a bike to work each year. Here is that change in three pictures: a trend, a move and a table.
In 2021, about 4 thousand people cycled to work each day. Two years later it was 7 thousand, and by 2025 it was 11 thousand.
So the bike's share of all trips to work moved from 6 percent to 17 percent in four years.
The centre gained the most. The north grew more slowly, and the harbour is still far behind.
The lesson is simple. Where the city built safe lanes first, the riders came next.
